about.title: About me
about.content: After completing my training as an IT specialist for system integration, I worked as a system administrator at a municipal data center. Since 2023, I've been working at OWL-IT as a Kubernetes Administrator and Deputy Team Lead (Linux). I focus on planning, building, and operating Kubernetes clusters, as well as developing an internal cloud management console. My expertise includes DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, security, and automation.
